rationale: Keep the current staged reverse-tail baseline, but add a tiny learned per-block recurrence gain on top of the existing schedule. This stays compile-stable, costs only a couple of scalars, survives export as a kept float control tensor, and gives the model a direct way to attenuate or amplify each recurrent tail block for the final int8 roundtrip objective instead of relying only on the fixed external curriculum.
title: Learned Tail Recurrence Block Gain
